context: The agent must implement a config write that has none of the four command-earning properties (no multi-record atomicity under contention, no idempotency stakes, no cross-brick reaction, no unreliable ingress) and explicitly wants read-your-writes. Key discriminator: without the idiom, an agent working in a codebase full of command-processor scaffolding may default to routing this through a command envelope (an Avro schema, a processor, a bus publish) out of habit or perceived consistency; with the idiom loaded, it knows a write earns command status only via one of four intrinsic properties, and a single-record admin config toggle with no reaction and no idempotency stakes stays a plain synchronous call.
